item.title: On This Day in 1962: Mariner 2 Makes History With First Successful Flyby of Venus
item.description: On this day in 1962, NASA’s Mariner 2 spacecraft made history with a close flyby of Venus, marking a major milestone in the early years of space exploration. The mission became America’s first definitive “first” in the space race, achieving the world’s first fully successful planetary flyby.
